name: autonomous-execution
description: Agent persistence and failure-recovery skills for pushing Codex toward evidence-backed execution loops.

interface.shortDescription: 用于失败恢复、主动排查和验证闭环的 Agent 执行技能。
interface.longDescription: Autonomous Execution packages skills that keep Codex moving when a task stalls: reading failure signals, switching approaches, checking assumptions, using tools proactively, and verifying the result before handoff.
defaultPrompt: Use pua when this task keeps failing and needs a fresh execution loop.
Apply pua to push through repeated debugging failures with evidence.
Use pua to avoid giving up before verifying alternative approaches.
